physical_definition: Keep original total calibrated legacy Ws and ocean column water, r39 source/sink/thermal/winds and Earth planetary profile. Solve two independent positive steady water amounts at each seasonal step, lower dry mass25%, upper75%. Diagnose donor vertical air exchange from lower continuity; total dry air remains balanced on exact common faces. Optional symmetric mixing conductance=M*.25*.75/(5days), or zero. Lower air alone receives sea/land evaporation, with original ocean exchange evaluated at actual lower water divided by moist-profile lower capacity fraction. Each layer rains against its normalized moist hydrostatic saturation fraction using the original closure; drying and linear conservative storms act on each actual layer. Moist profile only partitions capacity and boundary water; no reset of actual humidity. Keep legacy absolute capacities to isolate vertical water dynamics from the failed pressure-capacity experiment. Old fixed moisture_upper_q_ratio no longer controls solution (bit-exact coupled toy test). No resolved vertical temperature, time storage, latent heating or new momentum claim. Both actual per-layer and summed-column equations must meet unchanged residual tolerance, including actual updated evaporation switch, horizontal/vertical fluxes and storm exchange. Independent sparse-matrix residual required after fast block sweeps.
scope: 35 fixed actual coupled Earth runs,21 exact controls then14 candidates; all failures retained. At most2 predeclared qualifiers may proceed to full gates. Publish results and actual solved humidity diagnostics without replacing fantasy climate or headline score unless separate gates pass. Supervisor source-change stop and2h ceiling, no automatic exports or Git writes.
water_budget_drying_definition: column_drying includes monsoon_drying; other_column_drying is their difference. Only disjoint terms are stacked.
